name: dsh-ocr
description: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. doc_ocr turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) via a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine. doc_preprocess turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping.
